retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s mod-style layout featuring a central shield-shaped frame containing a collage of portraits, surrounded by thick concentric red, white, and blue stripes on a dark background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photo collage is encased in a thick, U-shaped shield frame composed of concentric red, white, and blue bands. The entire graphic sits on a dark charcoal field with bold, uppercase sans-serif text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric U-shaped stripes framing a central rectangular image
Repetitive portrait collage within the central frame
High-contrast primary colors against a dark background
Symmetrical balance between top and bottom display text
coreInvariants: The U-shaped shield frame must consist of at least three concentric color bands.
The central image must be a rectangular collage of human portraits.
The background must be a dark, solid neutral color.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a central rectangular collage occupying the middle 50% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick, vibrant red outer band of the shield frame acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, follows the curve of the shield down to the bottom text, and then settles on the central faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space at the corners and sides emphasizes the central graphic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan blue and yellow for typography and inner stripes
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors against a low-value dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace/Single-family pairing using color to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the British mod aesthetic and geometric proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark charcoal background with a central U-shaped shield frame made of concentric red, white, and blue stripes. Inside the shield, place a rectangular collage of multiple male portraits in 1960s attire.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in yellow at the top and cyan blue at the bottom, centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the shield frame composed of concentric red, white, and blue bands?
Is the text bold, uppercase, and sans-serif?
Is the background a solid dark neutral color?
Is the central image a rectangular collage of portraits?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the collage
mustRedesign: Do not use specific band logos
Do not use specific celebrity faces
Do not use trademarked album titles

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red band is the outermost part of the shield.
Ensure the text is perfectly centered.
Verify the collage is contained strictly within the inner white border.
Confirm the background is a consistent dark shade.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark background + Concentric primary-colored shield frame + Central portrait collage + Bold geometric sans-serif headers.
